messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How sort the data in the CSV file?
parts:
A sample data file is available at http://rqtl.org/sampledata/
Also see Chapter 2 of the R/qtl book, http://rqtl.org/book

Ideally, sort markers by chromosome and by position within each chromosome.
Individuals can be in any order.

karl
